name: highlight_keywords
description: Highlights matching text phrases across the current active page DOM with a yellow custom marker.
codeSnippet: const term = params.query || 'important'; const regex = new RegExp(`(${term})`, 'gi'); document.body.innerHTML = document.body.innerHTML.replace(regex, '<mark style="background-color: #ffeb3b; color: #000;">$1</mark>'); return { success: true, term };
